coverage.coverage_statement: Mapped from 97.97% of granted records in the pinned register; 233 unresolved rows are withheld from the map and reported here.

ceiling.grantIsNotBuilt: Granted administrative licences. A granted licence means an administrative grant was recorded; it is not evidence that work started, construction occurred or completed, occupancy happened, or the permitted quantity was built.
ceiling.noApprovalRate: Granted-only universe: no application or refusal denominator, so no approval, rejection or success rate exists.
ceiling.noCrossFamilyTotal: Building/urbanistic, activity and temporary-activity licences are three different families and are never summed into one total.

result.ceiling: A count of granted administrative urban licences spatially included in the Lens circle (scope ADDRESS_POINT), by family and grant-date window. GRANTED-ONLY: the register is RESOLUCION=Conceder, so there is no applications/refusals denominator and NO approval rate, rejection rate, refusal count or success rate exists. A granted licence is NOT evidence that work started, construction occurred or completed, occupancy happened, or the permitted quantity was built: granted is not built. The three families (building/urbanistic, activity, temporary activity) are NOT one homogeneous universe and are NEVER summed into a single cross-family total. The mapped layer is the RESOLVED SUBSET of the register; unresolved rows are reported in the coverage metadata and never dropped from the denominator. The crosswalk may resolve via current or historical official callejero, with distinct current/historical administrative-geography provenance. Licence records may concern places also present in Censo de Locales, licensed VUT or hospitality/activity evidence; these universes are NEVER summed as unique businesses or sites. Counts are ADDRESS_POINT records and are never converted into a barrio-level figure, ranked by barrio or district, or rendered as a density, heatmap or choropleth surface. Responsible declarations (dataset 133556) are not ingested.

registerComposition.basis: Distinct `tipo` names observed, per family, among the located records of the pinned licence artifact. Unlocated rows are not part of this composition, so their types are not included. It covers all dates and all families present in that artifact, independently of the query.
registerComposition.note: Not filtered by circle, window or family, and it carries no counts. The presence of a type here does not show that it appears in the requested circle or window (`tipo` is not reported per result, and this tool cannot say how many licences of a type a circle contains). The absence of a type here does not show that it is absent from the complete source register.

value.interpretationCeiling: A count of granted administrative urban licences spatially included in the Lens circle (scope ADDRESS_POINT), by family and grant-date window. GRANTED-ONLY: the register is RESOLUCION=Conceder, so there is no applications/refusals denominator and NO approval rate, rejection rate, refusal count or success rate exists. A granted licence is NOT evidence that work started, construction occurred or completed, occupancy happened, or the permitted quantity was built: granted is not built. The three families (building/urbanistic, activity, temporary activity) are NOT one homogeneous universe and are NEVER summed into a single cross-family total. The mapped layer is the RESOLVED SUBSET of the register; unresolved rows are reported in the coverage metadata and never dropped from the denominator. The crosswalk may resolve via current or historical official callejero, with distinct current/historical administrative-geography provenance. Licence records may concern places also present in Censo de Locales, licensed VUT or hospitality/activity evidence; these universes are NEVER summed as unique businesses or sites. Counts are ADDRESS_POINT records and are never converted into a barrio-level figure, ranked by barrio or district, or rendered as a density, heatmap or choropleth surface. Responsible declarations (dataset 133556) are not ingested.

content.text:
No puedo darle esa cifra. Lens no permite saber cuántos edificios de obra nueva se terminaron.

- **Lo que sí hay:** en un radio de 600 m de la Puerta de Alcalá, entre 2025-10-01 y 2026-09-30 (los últimos 12 meses del registro), Lens cuenta 18 licencias de la familia «edificación/urbanística».
- **Por qué no sirve:** esa familia mezcla licencias residenciales, licencias sujetas a la Ley 3/2024 y licencias de 1ª ocupación y funcionamiento. La herramienta no desglosa el tipo (`tipo`) en cada resultado, así que no puedo aislar las de primera ocupación.
- **Otros límites:** una licencia concedida no prueba que se construyera ni que se terminara nada. Además, una licencia de 1ª ocupación puede referirse a una reforma y no a obra nueva, y no equivale a un edificio, porque cada licencia es un registro, no un inmueble.
- **Cobertura:** el 2,03 % de los registros no se pudo ubicar, y no se incluye en el recuento.

Para obtener la cifra, habría que filtrar por tipo «Licencia de 1ª ocupación y funcionamiento» directamente en el dataset del Ayuntamiento (datos.madrid.es, conjunto 640505).
